q: In a code, PEN is written as ODM. Using the same code, how is INK written?
x: Each letter is moved one place back in the alphabet (P to O, E to D, N to M). So I, N, K become H, M, J.

q: In a code, MILK is written as KGJI. Using the same code, how is RICE written?
x: Each letter is moved two places back (M to K, I to G, L to J, K to I). So R, I, C, E become P, G, A, C.

q: In a code language, "tak lo mi" means "clean your room", "mi sar pe" means "room is big" and "pe dun tak" means "big clean house". What is the code for "house"?
x: 'mi' is common to the first two (room), 'pe' to the last two (big) and 'tak' to the first and third (clean). The remaining word in the third phrase, 'dun', means house.

q: When a number is doubled and 5 is added, the result is 29. If the same number is then divided by 3, what is the result?
x: 2n + 5 = 29 gives n = 12. Then 12 divided by 3 = 4.

q: Five years ago, Sara was twice as old as Ali. Ali is 15 years old now. How old will Sara be three years from now?
x: Five years ago Ali was 10, so Sara was 20; she is 25 now and will be 28 in three years.

q: If 5 March of a certain year is a Tuesday, what day of the week is 30 March of the same year?
x: 30 March is 25 days after 5 March. 25 = 3 weeks + 4 days, and 4 days after Tuesday is Saturday.

q: Four chairs in a line are numbered 1 to 4 from left to right. Usman takes chair 1. Ali's chair is neither of the end chairs, and Bilal's is the chair just to Ali's right. Hamza is not beside Usman. Who takes chair 4?
x: Ali and Bilal take chairs 2-3 or 3-4. If they took 3-4, Hamza would be in chair 2 beside Usman, which is not allowed. So Ali is 2, Bilal 3 and Hamza 4.

q: The sign @ is defined so that x @ y means x × y + x. What is the value of (2 @ 3) @ 1?

Ali can paint a wall in 6 hours, and Bilal can paint the same kind of wall in 3 hours. They paint one wall together, and then Ali alone paints a second, identical wall. How many hours does the whole job take?
x: Together they paint 1/6 + 1/3 = 1/2 of a wall per hour, so the first wall takes 2 hours. Ali alone needs 6 hours for the second: 2 + 6 = 8 hours.

q: P, Q, R, S and W are five boxes of different weights. P is heavier than Q. Q is heavier than S. R is lighter than S. If W is lighter than R, which box is in the middle by weight?
x: From heaviest: P, Q, S, R, W. The third of five is S.

q: A clock gains 2 minutes every hour. It is set to the correct time at 8:00 a.m. Later the same day it shows 2:12 p.m. What is the correct time then?
x: The clock shows 62 minutes for every 60 real minutes. It has shown 6 hours 12 minutes = 372 minutes, which is 372 × 60 / 62 = 360 real minutes, so the time is 2:00 p.m.

q: Ali, Hamza and Bilal each have a bicycle of a different colour: red, blue or green. Ali's bicycle is neither red nor blue. Hamza's bicycle is not red. What colour is Bilal's bicycle?
x: Ali's must be green. Hamza's is not red, so it is blue. Bilal's is the one left, red.

q: Sana, Hina and Nida are a pharmacist, a dentist and a lawyer, one each. Hina is not the pharmacist. Nida is neither the dentist nor the pharmacist. Who is the pharmacist?
x: Nida must be the lawyer. Hina is not the pharmacist, so she is the dentist, leaving Sana as the pharmacist.

q: Five students got different marks in a test. Sana got more than Zain but less than Omar. Hira got less than Zain. Kinza got more than Omar. Who got the second lowest marks?
x: From highest: Kinza, Omar, Sana, Zain, Hira. Hira is lowest, so Zain is second lowest.

q: Danish, Ehsan, Faiza, Gul and Hassan each visit the library on a different day from Monday to Friday. Danish goes on Thursday. Ehsan goes the day before Danish. Faiza goes on a day after Danish. Gul goes on an earlier day than Hassan. Who goes on Tuesday?
x: Ehsan is Wednesday and Faiza Friday. Monday and Tuesday remain, and Gul is earlier than Hassan, so Gul is Monday and Hassan Tuesday.

q: Five boxes, blue, green, red, white and yellow, are stacked one on top of another. The green box is at the bottom, and the yellow box is directly on top of it. The blue box is directly on top of the red box. The white box is somewhere above the blue box. Which box is in the middle of the stack?
x: Green is 1st and yellow 2nd from the bottom. Red, blue and white fill places 3 to 5, with blue on red and white above blue, so red is 3rd: the middle.

q: Four sisters, Aiza, Bisma, Dua and Eman, each play a different sport: badminton, cricket, hockey or tennis. Aiza plays neither cricket nor tennis. Bisma plays hockey. Dua does not play cricket. Who plays cricket?
x: With hockey taken by Bisma, Aiza must play badminton. Dua does not play cricket, so she plays tennis, and Eman plays cricket.

q: Junaid, Kashif and Luqman live in Lahore, Multan and Quetta, and drive black, silver and white cars, one each. The man from Multan drives the silver car. Kashif drives the white car. Luqman does not live in Multan. The driver of the black car lives in Lahore. Who lives in Quetta?
x: Kashif's car is white, so he is not the Multan man; Luqman is not either, so Junaid lives in Multan and drives silver. Luqman then drives black and lives in Lahore, leaving Kashif in Quetta.

q: Ayesha thinks of a two-digit number. Its digits add up to 11, and its tens digit is 3 more than its units digit. What is the number?
x: Tens + units = 11 and tens - units = 3, so tens = 7 and units = 4: the number is 74. 47 has the digits the wrong way round.

q: Exactly one of Ali, Bilal and Hamza broke a window. Ali says, "Bilal did it." Bilal says, "I did not do it." Hamza says, "I did not do it." If exactly one of the three is telling the truth, who broke the window?
x: If Ali or Bilal did it, two of the statements would be true. Only if Hamza did it is just one statement (Bilal's) true.

q: Five houses in a row, numbered 1 to 5 from the left, are painted blue, green, red, white and yellow, one colour each. The red house is in the middle. The blue house is at the left end. The green house is immediately to the left of the white house. What colour is house 2?
x: Blue is 1 and red is 3. Green and white need two side-by-side places, which can only be 4 and 5, so house 2 is yellow.

q: Box P is heavier than box Q. Box R is lighter than box Q. Which of the three boxes is the heaviest?
x: P is heavier than Q, and Q is heavier than R, so P is the heaviest.
